status: registered, source not admitted, not run
role: Read-only same-state decomposition of filtered steering rejection; no command intervention or learning
case_role: Same 136 development cases reused in each seed/condition; 816 episodes are not independent cases
hypothesis: Leg constraints bind the global scaling factor beyond the two-wheel command box in the learned-leg/fixed-assist context; existing aggregate acceptance ratios cannot distinguish this from wheel-only headroom

known_fields: original global lambda and accepted wheel diagnostics
counterfactual.timing: Read-only immediately after original controller, before physics; post-room wheels unchanged
counterfactual.lambda_wheel: clip(min(1, (bound_j-base_j)/r_j if r_j>0; (-bound_j-base_j)/r_j if r_j<0),0,1), j=4,5; r=(steering,-steering)
counterfactual.decomposition: r-lambda*r = (r-lambda_wheel*r) + (lambda_wheel-lambda)*r; record all terms in diagnostic torque units
counterfactual.loss_statistics: Use absolute-loss sums for additive shares. Squared-loss energies require the cross term; do not add RMS values or pretend their energies are additive.
counterfactual.interpretation: lambda_wheel is a same-state wheel-only box counterfactual, not a safe dynamic controller or a new rollout; does not predict trajectory/reward/learning benefit
counterfactual.aggregation: Per seed/panel/condition, RMS over all valid active physical substeps through first terminal, including zero requests; absolute-loss share uses left steering losses over the same substeps. Also retain per-case values. Zero rejection denominator is undefined and cannot pass the gate.

decision_gate.scope: Only whether a future bounded allocation intervention has enough available authority to be worth registration; never learner promotion
decision_gate.threshold_rationale: Recoverable RMS of 0.01 Nm is 1/30 of the fixed 0.3 Nm request cap; coupling must also explain at least one fifth of rejection. Predeclared diagnostic screening thresholds, not task success or safety gates.
decision_gate.otherwise: Close this current coupling-recovery hypothesis; no grouped projection revival, gain/budget sweep or new PPO
decision_gate.if_pass: Only register one matched-context physical/task allocation intervention, with original limits and nondegradation. Do not enable old grouped_residual, train, or claim novel safety.

limits: Zero-leg accepted/filter RMS is already about 0.767-0.847: wheel-only suppression is present.
Frozen policy was trained without fixed assist. This study does not fix or test training context mismatch.
Current q/v are ideal lower-layer simulation inputs. Counterfactual logged after action never enters actor/critic.
No coupled next-state, invariant working-domain, independent OOD or control novelty proof.
Old strong-reference and room mechanism gates remain failed; no final sealed cases used.
next: 156 admit minimal read-only implementation and synthetic/owner/reset checks, then one registered queue if admitted; next turn reviews full result and closes or registers a specific bounded intervention. No automatic new training.
